text: {"name":"phy_process_config","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes the selected PHY configuration entry, coordinating its context state and hardware or firmware readiness.","subsystem":"phy","var_renames":{"v1":"phy_id","v2":"phy_config_entry","v5":"config_slot","v6":"phy_context","v8":"phy_context_state","v41":"phy_bit","v42":"phy_bit_clear_mask"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":26,"meaning":"Configuration-entry byte flag checked before processing"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"List head passed to list_pop"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Pointer to the associated PHY context"},{"offset":80,"meaning":"Configuration-entry mode byte, compared against 1"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"PHY-context control/status halfword; bit 0x20 is polled"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Signed PHY-context field used as a readiness gate"},{"offset":88,"meaning":"PHY-context field used as an alternate readiness condition"},{"offset":144,"meaning":"Signed PHY-context state/status; negative values trigger processing"}]}
